C53550.observed: Checked on the live Production site. An invoice was saved as a file earlier in this testing while the shop was on the old look - the copy a customer would be holding. The shop was then switched to the new look, and that saved file was examined again: it is byte for byte the same file, 29,208 bytes, with an identical fingerprint before and after. Nothing about a copy already in someone's hands changes when the shop changes its look. Separately, and as expected, opening the same document fresh in the app after the switch does show it in the new look - it is only the already-saved copy that stays as it was.
